newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Air Hong Kong lifts ex-Europe cargo rates.
newsitem.headline: Air Hong Kong lifts ex-Europe cargo rates.

text.p: Air Hong Kong (AHK) is increasing its rates ex-Europe from March, said the company's European general manager, Marcel Buelens, in a statement.
Rates will rise on the Europe-Middle East/Asia routes. Increases will be between five and eight percent, he added. These increases are separate from the fuel surcharge which will remain in place.
A second rise is planned for September this year, said AHK which is a subsidiary of Cathay Pacific .
The airline introduced an increase in November last year of around two to three percent level.
As well as this, the carrier imposed a fuel surcharge of ten U.S. cents on November 5. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
